(a)	The Company has not defaulted in repayment of loan and payment of interest thereon to the lender.

(b)	The Company has not been declared wilful defaulter by any bank or financial institution or other lender.

(c)	The Company has not taken any term loan during the year and therefore, reporting under clause 3(ix)(c) of the Order is not applicable.

(d)	On an overall examination of the financial statements of the Company, funds raised on short-term basis have, prima facie, not been used during the year for long-term purposes by the Company.

(e)	On an overall examination of the Standalone Financial Statements of the Company, the Company has not taken any funds from any entity or person on account of or to meet the obligations of its subsidiary. 

(f)	The Company has not raised any loans during the year and therefore reporting on clause3(ix)(f) of the Order is not applicable.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Arising out of Audit objection ,Notice u/s 148 of Income Tax was issued on 29.06.2021 for AY 2016-17. Writ petition was filed against the said notice. Consequently department was directed to follow the the prescribed procedure u/s 148A of the Act. Order u/s 148A(d) was issued on 26.07.2022 and a notice was issued on 27.07.2022. The writ petition agaisnt the said notice was filed and proceedigns have been stayed by Hon'ble High Court of Gujarat.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax Center Circle (1) (2)
tax_litigation.status: Hon'ble High Court has passed the order dated 08/07/2025 and quashed and set aside the notice dated 27/07/2022 and all consequential proceedings are also quashed and set aside.

For F.Y. 2020-21 to 2023-24,Audit has been conducted by CGST Audit Commissionerate, Ahmedabad. Following poits remains unsettled during Audit and SCN has been issued on 01/04/2026 with following ponits. 1) Observation by Department:-Exclusion of Interest Income while calculating Exempt Turnover. Amount of Discipancy:- Rs.43,24,665/-. Stand of The Sandesh Limited:-We have argument that The allegation is misconceived as explaination-1 to rule 43 for the purpose of Rule 42 (determining common credit available & exempt income) sepcifically excludes interest . 2) Observation by Department:- ITC taken on Calendar printing considered as taken for Non Business Purpose. Amount of Discripancy:- Rs. 10,75,795/-.Stand of The Sandesh Limited:-The allegation is not sustainable as printing and distribution of calender in lieu of regular supplement on the occation of new year for the purpose of a bussiness and is generally followed by most of publication. 3) Observation by Department:- ITC taken on decorative items not allowed due to being considered under blocked credit. Amount of Discripancy:- Rs. 76,826/-.Stand of The Sandesh Limited:-ITC on decorative items is not covered under any of clause of section 17(5) of CGST Act.
